title: Answer for a work account
summary: The person's side of company-team-add: a phone joins a work account by scanning the Responsável's code. The person needs no personal account and no invite, because this path creates no account.

phase.description: scan: the camera. checkCode: the 2-digit number. joining: secrets sync, then the claim. failed: see error.

checkCode.description: The 2-digit number from the login progress.

open.effect: From account-new or account-start, row bipe_team_join_row: opens the camera, as recovery-old-phone does.

scanned.effect: Runs the QR login of recovery-old-phone. Stores no hidden password, recovery token or PIN for this account.

claim.effect: After sign-in: a new attestation challenge, then POST /v1/me/business/seats/claim. Success opens company-team-welcome. attestation_invalid shows bipe_team_join_attest_failed and signs this account out of the phone. seat_window_closed shows bipe_team_add_expired and signs it out.

notes: This phone has no hidden password, so it cannot approve a device or a web session (link-computer-scan needsPin does not apply; the row does not show).
The account's type is company, so it does not count against the personal cap.
bipe_account_new_existing keeps its meaning: an account the person made.
